reintegration_details.converted_sql: SELECT BusinessEntityID, TO_CHAR(ModifiedDate, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS FormattedModifiedDate, DATE_PART('year', AGE(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, BirthDate))::INTEGER AS Age FROM bobsbookstore_dbo.author WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM HireDate) = @HireDate;
reintegration_details.changes_made: Replaced SQL Server date/time functions with PostgreSQL equivalents: FORMAT() -> TO_CHAR(), DATEDIFF(YEAR, d1, d2) -> DATE_PART('year', AGE(d2, d1))::INTEGER, GETDATE() -> CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, DATEPART(YEAR, date) -> EXTRACT(YEAR FROM date)

reintegration_details.notes: Date format codes changed from MS SQL format (yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss) to PostgreSQL format (YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS). Age calculation uses PostgreSQL AGE function with type cast to INTEGER.
